name: Thibaut's Cairn
summary: Thibaut's Cairn is a crypt in central Reaper's March, east of Vinedusk Village containing undead. The Cairn is named for its most noted "guest," the famed Thibault of Kvatch. Thibault was a general of Colovia, and in his time some hundreds of years ago he was one of the anchor points for the Hastrel Cohort. The details of Thibault's death have been lost. Fleshflies and rats are found in numbers inside. Rithlen the traveling merchant can be found walking along the road east of the cairn.
notes: The boss for Thibaut's Cairn was originally found in an outside higher area after going through and exiting the delve. Now the boss is inside and the outside area has one Ghost, one Skeletal Blademaster and one Skeletal Marksman.
